job.command:
stardev
# Flatten sim_to_jet/ into the job's working dir (StRoot/ and # .sl73_x8664_gcc485/ stay as-is -- the build system expects those paths). cp sim_to_jet/* . cp shared/* .
if ( "{{GENERATOR}}" == "pythia8" ) then ln -sf starsim_pythia8_filter.C starsim.C set pid = "pythia8" else ln -sf starsim_pythia6_filter.C starsim.C set pid = "pythia6" endif
set seed_temp=`od -vAn -N4 -tu4 < /dev/urandom` set myseed=`expr ${seed_temp} % 100000` set run_number = ${JOBINDEX}
# ptHatMin for this job (see header comment) {{PTCUT_BLOCK}}
echo "========================================" echo "Generator = {{GENERATOR}} (tune/PDF param={{TUNE_PARAM}})" echo "ptHatMin = ${ptcut} GeV" echo "FcsJetFilter Ethr = {{FILTER_ETHR}} GeV" echo "nevents = {{NEVENTS}}" echo "Save SimpleTree = {{SAVE_SIMPLETREE}}" echo "JOBINDEX = ${JOBINDEX}" echo "Random seed = ${myseed}" echo "========================================"
mkdir -p {{OUTDIR}}
echo "Starting detector simulation..."
root4star -q -b starsim.C\({{NEVENTS}},${myseed},${ptcut},{{TUNE_PARAM}},{{FILTER_ETHR}}\)
echo "Finished detector simulation."
# Rescue StarPrimaryMaker's end-of-run StarGenStats file (cross # section for this job's ptHatMin cut, read back by readMudst.C's # ReadMCXSec()) before runSimBfc.C's own output file -- which # collides on the exact same name, ${pid}.starsim.root -- silently # overwrites it below. ${ptcut} itself (the ptHatMin cut value, not # just its resulting cross section) is passed straight through to # readMudst.C below and recorded on every row as mc_pthatmin_gev. mv ${pid}.starsim.root ${pid}.genstats.root
echo "" echo "Starting reconstruction..."
# Full positional arg list needed so {{CALIB_RUN}} (last param) can # be set -- CINT can't skip earlier args; rest are runSimBfc.C's own defaults. root4star -b -q runSimBfc.C\({{NEVENTS}},1,\"${pid}\",202207,0,0,1.5,0.0,\"0.0100\",0,0,input_dir,output_dir,input_chain,0,{{CALIB_RUN}}\) root4star -b -q readMudst.C\(0,1,\"${pid}.MuDst.root\",\".\",\"\",202209,${ptcut}\)
echo "Finished reconstruction."
# Jet finding: JetMatcher takes a list-file arg, so write a one-line list. module purge module load fastjet-3.3.4 module load root-5.34.38
echo "Compiling JetMatcher..." g++ -m64 JetMatcher.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o JetMatcher \ `root-config --cflags --libs` -lEG \ `fastjet-config --cxxflags --libs` -std=c++11
set TRIGGER_FILTER = "{{TRIGGER_FILTER}}"
echo "SimpleTree_mudst.root" > single_file.list
./JetMatcher single_file.list "${TRIGGER_FILTER}" mv jet_output.root jet_output_{{GENERATOR}}_{{TUNE_PARAM}}_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root
if ( {{SAVE_SIMPLETREE}} == 1 ) then mv SimpleTree_mudst.root SimpleTree_{{GENERATOR}}_{{TUNE_PARAM}}_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root else rm -f SimpleTree_mudst.root endif
# Temporary, job-local only; never meant to leave scratch. Its # useful content (sigmaGen/nAccepted) is already baked into every # jetTree/SimpleTree row above via mc_sigma_pb/mc_n_gen. rm -f single_file.list ${pid}.genstats.root
echo "Files in scratch:" ls -l
